statement_blocker: The catalog fixes only Kneser's name, the year 1953, and the gloss 'structure of sumsets over abelian groups'. It does not select the ambient group, subset model, finiteness/topology/measurability and nonemptiness assumptions, density/cardinality/measure invariant, existential period subgroup versus canonical stabilizer, exact inequality or structural dichotomy, ordered binders, or degenerate cases. Selecting the familiar finite stabilizer inequality at intake would add proposition-changing mathematics.
